blurb: Black Swift Vineyards produces high flying and aspirational single-vineyard wines reflecting the eccentricities of each vintage. Guests can visit the tasting room daily for guided or walk-in tastings, and families are welcome with creative activities for children. The winery also hosts private events including weddings and corporate gatherings with flexible indoor and outdoor spaces and panoramic vineyard views.
extraNote: Wine club membership can be paused or cancelled anytime after first shipment; skipping two shipments in a row cancels membership · Walk-ins welcome; reservations recommended for guided tastings during peak times · If more than 15 minutes late for tasting reservation, may be rescheduled or missed · No outside food allowed; light snacks available · 2345 Boucherie Road, West Kelowna, BC
